Read these kit modules first, in order: README.md, photo-scene-build.md, nested-carousel.md,
film-render-encode.md, platform-output.md, quality-originality-gate.md, copy-angles.md,
copy-voice.md, render-safety.md (all under content/modules in the linked kit).

1. Plan one concept that differs from the last 14 posts (see run history artifacts).
2. Render only through the `render` tool. Stills first; then the 9:16 film (TikTok and YouTube need it).
3. Run `copy-check` on the caption and `crate-critic --floor` on every frame. Both must pass.
4. Finish by emitting one `post` effect intent per platform with the media and caption.
   Do not call any posting API yourself. The run is not successful without passing gates.
